name: Allopurinol
advice: Take after food. Drink plenty of water during the day.
advice_id: Minum setelah makan. Minum banyak air sepanjang hari.

name: Amlodipine
advice: Take at the same time each day.
advice_id: Minum pada jam yang sama setiap hari.

name: Amoxicillin
advice: Space the doses evenly through the day.
advice_id: Beri jarak waktu yang sama antar dosis sepanjang hari.

name: Aspirin (low dose)
advice: Take with food to protect the stomach.
advice_id: Minum bersama makanan untuk melindungi lambung.

name: Atenolol
advice: Take at the same time each day.
advice_id: Minum pada jam yang sama setiap hari.

name: Atorvastatin
advice: Can be taken at any time of day.
advice_id: Dapat diminum kapan saja dalam sehari.

name: Azithromycin
advice: Take once a day at the same time.
advice_id: Minum sekali sehari pada jam yang sama.

name: Bisoprolol
advice: Take in the morning at the same time each day.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari di jam yang sama setiap hari.

name: Cetirizine
advice: Some people feel a little sleepy. Taking it in the evening can help.
advice_id: Sebagian orang merasa sedikit mengantuk. Minum pada malam hari dapat membantu.

name: Chlorphenamine (chlorpheniramine)
advice: This medicine often causes sleepiness.
advice_id: Obat ini sering menyebabkan kantuk.

name: Ciprofloxacin
advice: Take 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids, iron, calcium or zinc.
advice_id: Minum 2 jam sebelum atau 6 jam sesudah antasida, zat besi, kalsium, atau seng.

name: Clopidogrel
advice: Do not stop before talking to your doctor.
advice_id: Jangan berhenti sebelum berbicara dengan dokter.

name: Diazepam
advice: Causes sleepiness. Usually for short-term use.
advice_id: Menyebabkan kantuk. Biasanya untuk pemakaian jangka pendek.

name: Doxycycline
advice: Stay upright for 30 minutes after each dose, so not at bedtime. Keep 2 hours away from antacids, iron or calcium.
advice_id: Tetap dalam posisi tegak selama 30 menit setelah minum, jadi jangan sebelum tidur. Beri jarak 2 jam dari antasida, zat besi, atau kalsium.

name: Empagliflozin
advice: Take in the morning. Drink enough fluids.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari. Minum cukup cairan.

name: Enalapril
advice: A dry cough can happen. Tell your pharmacist if it starts.
advice_id: Batuk kering dapat terjadi. Beri tahu apoteker jika muncul.

name: Famotidine
advice: Often taken at bedtime.
advice_id: Sering diminum sebelum tidur.

name: Fluoxetine
advice: Take in the morning so it does not keep you awake at night.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari agar tidak sulit tidur di malam hari.

name: Furosemide
advice: Take in the morning, or by early afternoon, so you do not need to pass urine at night.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari, atau paling lambat siang hari, agar tidak perlu buang air kecil di malam hari.

name: Gabapentin
advice: Can cause sleepiness and dizziness.
advice_id: Dapat menyebabkan kantuk dan pusing.

name: Glipizide
advice: Take about 30 minutes before a meal. Do not skip the meal.
advice_id: Minum sekitar 30 menit sebelum makan. Jangan melewatkan makan.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
advice: Take in the morning so you do not need to pass urine at night.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari agar tidak perlu buang air kecil di malam hari.

name: Ibuprofen
advice: Take with food or milk to protect the stomach.
advice_id: Minum bersama makanan atau susu untuk melindungi lambung.

name: Levothyroxine
advice: Take on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
advice_id: Minum saat perut kosong, 30 sampai 60 menit sebelum sarapan.

name: Loratadine
advice: Take once a day.
advice_id: Minum sekali sehari.

name: Lorazepam
advice: Causes sleepiness. Usually for short-term use.
advice_id: Menyebabkan kantuk. Biasanya untuk pemakaian jangka pendek.

name: Losartan
advice: Take at the same time each day.
advice_id: Minum pada jam yang sama setiap hari.

name: Metformin
advice: Take with meals to reduce stomach upset.
advice_id: Minum bersama makanan untuk mengurangi gangguan lambung.

name: Metronidazole
advice: No alcohol during the course and for at least 3 days after.
advice_id: Jangan minum alkohol selama pengobatan dan setidaknya 3 hari sesudahnya.

name: Montelukast
advice: Usually taken in the evening.
advice_id: Biasanya diminum pada malam hari.

name: Naproxen
advice: Take with food or milk to protect the stomach.
advice_id: Minum bersama makanan atau susu untuk melindungi lambung.

name: Omeprazole
advice: Take 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
advice_id: Minum 30 sampai 60 menit sebelum sarapan.

name: Pantoprazole
advice: Can be taken with or without food. Take at the same time each day.
advice_id: Dapat diminum dengan atau tanpa makanan. Minum pada jam yang sama setiap hari.

name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)
advice: Check other medicines for hidden paracetamol.
advice_id: Periksa obat lain yang mungkin juga mengandung parasetamol.

name: Paracetamol + caffeine
advice: Contains paracetamol. Do not take with other paracetamol products.
advice_id: Mengandung parasetamol. Jangan diminum bersama produk lain yang mengandung parasetamol.

name: Prednisone
advice: Take in the morning with food.
advice_id: Minum pada pagi hari bersama makanan.

name: Rosuvastatin
advice: Can be taken at any time of day.
advice_id: Dapat diminum kapan saja dalam sehari.

name: Sertraline
advice: It can take a few weeks to feel the full benefit.
advice_id: Manfaat penuh baru terasa setelah beberapa minggu.

name: Simvastatin
advice: Usually taken in the evening.
advice_id: Biasanya diminum pada malam hari.

name: Sitagliptin
advice: Take once a day with or without food.
advice_id: Minum sekali sehari, dengan atau tanpa makanan.

name: Tamsulosin
advice: Take 30 minutes after the same meal each day. Stand up slowly.
advice_id: Minum 30 menit setelah makan yang sama setiap hari. Berdiri perlahan.

name: Tramadol
advice: Can cause sleepiness and constipation.
advice_id: Dapat menyebabkan kantuk dan sembelit.

name: Warfarin
advice: Take at the same time each day. Keep the amount of leafy green vegetables steady.
advice_id: Minum pada jam yang sama setiap hari. Jaga jumlah sayuran hijau tetap stabil.
